'''Ooroz''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and was known for only eating animals and plants that were specially engineered by his [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] in his tasting laboratories.<ref name="Mission" />
